name: AZ-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Grijalva with large fundraising edge
Republican opponent underfunded with minimal cash
model.rationale: The baseline's D+21.8 margin rests on a solidly Democratic seat, incumbency, and a dominant financial advantage, and nothing in the dossier contradicts it. Polymarket's 95% Democratic odds corroborate a Safe D rating.
model.watch: Any late polling showing an unusually weak Democratic margin or a surge of outside spending against Grijalva would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Adelita Grijalva, the Democratic incumbent in a district with a 13-point Democratic lean, faces Republican Daniel Butierez in the general election. The fundamentals strongly favor the Democratic side: the seat's partisan baseline, the incumbency advantage, and a favorable political environment all point the same direction.

Financially the race is lopsided. Grijalva has raised roughly ten times what Butierez has, holds a large cash-on-hand edge, and benefits from modest outside support while facing little organized opposition spending. Butierez has almost no cash on hand and no outside backing. With no public polling and no expert ratings, the forecast leans on fundamentals, which support a Safe D rating with a margin in the low twenties.
